_comment: PLACEHOLDER — the project builds with this file so a fresh checkout produces a real APK, but Firebase Auth/Firestore/Messaging will not actually work until you replace this with the real file. Firebase console → palousefellowshipsermonapp project → Project settings → Add app → Android, package com.palousefellowship.audio → download google-services.json → overwrite this file. This is not a secret (same trust level as an API key shipped in any client app) so it's fine to commit the real one too if you'd rather not keep it gitignored — see README.md 'Firebase & Supabase setup'.
